The '''Jahilid Drift''' was a region of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Koltine]] and [[Pral]].

==Astrography==
The Jahilid Drift was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] contained [[Koltine]], [[Pral]] and other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="Hyperspace" /> The [[Jahilid system/Legends|Jahilid system]] was probably located within or near this region.<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] Imperial [[General/Legends|general]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] led a strike force to [[Subjugation of the Jahilid Drift|conquer]] several worlds along the Jahilid Drift, including [[Subjugation of Pral|Pral]] and [[Subjugation of Koltine|Koltine]]. Sk'ar's victories in the region led to a boost in his reputation, even among the most [[Speciesism|speciesist]] Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that the Jahilid Drift was a region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later established that the Jahilid Drift was actually located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jason Fry, co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', confirmed during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Wild Space localization prevails.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref>
